mapper.update: UPDATE grade SET alphabet = #{alphabet}, GPA = #{gpa}, score = #{score}, total_int = #{totalInt}, mid_exam = #{midExam, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, final_exam = #{finalExam, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, assignment = #{assignment, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, attendance = #{attendance, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.alphabet, g.gpa AS GPA, g.score, g.total_int, g.mid_exam, g.final_exam, g.assignment, g.attendance, g.student_id, g.enrollment_id, sj.name AS subjectName, s.student_num AS studentNo, u.name AS studentName FROM grade g JOIN enrollment e ON g.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN subject sj ON c.subject_id = sj.id LEFT JOIN student s ON g.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT g.id, g.alphabet, g.gpa AS GPA, g.score, g.total_int, g.mid_exam, g.final_exam, g.assignment, g.attendance, g.student_id, g.enrollment_id, sj.name AS subjectName, s.student_num AS studentNo, u.name AS studentName FROM grade g JOIN enrollment e ON g.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN subject sj ON c.subject_id = sj.id LEFT JOIN student s ON g.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE g.id = #{id}

AND course_id = #{subjectId}
AND course_id = ( SELECT c.subject_id FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.id = #{enrollmentId} )
ORDER BY boundary DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject s
AND UPPER(s.name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND s.id = TO_NUMBER(#{searchKeyword})
AND (UPPER(s.name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' OR (REGEXP_LIKE(#{searchKeyword}, '^[0-9]+$') AND s.id = TO_NUMBER(#{searchKeyword})))
SELECT c.subject_id FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.id = #{enrollmentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT g.id, g.alphabet, g.gpa AS GPA, g.score, g.total_int, g.mid_exam, g.final_exam, g.assignment, g.attendance, g.student_id, g.enrollment_id FROM grade g JOIN enrollment e ON g.enrollment_id = e.id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY g.total_int DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.course_id = ( SELECT course_id FROM enrollment WHERE id = #{enrollmentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )

SELECT e.id as enrollmentId, s.id as studentId, s.student_num as studentNo, u.name as studentName FROM enrollment e JOIN student s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON e.id = g.enrollment_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND g.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.student_num

SELECT id, course_id as courseId, mid_exam_ratio as midExamRatio, final_exam_ratio as finalExamRatio, assignment_ratio as assignmentRatio, attendance_ratio as attendanceRatio FROM grade_system WHERE course_id = #{courseId} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT id, professor_id as professorId, subject_id as subjectId, semester_id as semesterId, capacity, num_of_student as numOfStudent, day_of_week as dayOfWeek, place, status, time FROM course WHERE id = #{courseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e INNER JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN subject s ON c.subject_id = s.id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId}
AND UPPER(s.name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND s.id = TO_NUMBER(#{searchKeyword})
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM grade g WHERE g.enrollment_id = e.id AND UPPER(g.alphabet) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' )
AND (UPPER(s.name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' OR (REGEXP_LIKE(#{searchKeyword}, '^[0-9]+$') AND s.id = TO_NUMBER(#{searchKeyword})) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM grade g WHERE g.enrollment_id = e.id AND UPPER(g.alphabet) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) || '%' ))

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sem.id) as "SEMESTER", NVL(SUM(sub.credit), 0) as "APPLIED_CREDITS", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL THEN sub.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) as "ACQUIRED_CREDITS", NVL(AVG(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL THEN g.gpa / 10.0 END), 0) as "AVERAGE_GPA" FROM semester sem LEFT JOIN course c ON sem.id = c.semester_id LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON c.id = e.course_id AND e.student_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN subject sub ON c.subject_id = sub.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON e.id = g.enrollment_id GROUP BY sem.id ORDER BY sem.id

SELECT sub.id as "subjectId", sub.name as "subjectName", sub.credit as "credit", g.alphabet as "alphabet", CASE WHEN g.gpa IS NOT NULL THEN g.gpa / 10.0 ELSE NULL END as "gpa" FROM grade g INNER JOIN enrollment e ON g.enrollment_id = e.id INNER JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN semester sem ON c.semester_id = sem.id INNER JOIN subject sub ON c.subject_id = sub.id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND sem.id = #{semesterId} ORDER BY g.id DESC

SELECT s.id as "studentId", s.student_num as "studentNo", u.name as "studentName", u.email as "email", u.phone as "phone", d.dept_name as "major", SUBSTR(s.student_num, 1, 4) as "admissionYear" FROM student s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON s.dept_id = d.id WHERE s.id = #{studentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
